departments.name: Computer Engineering
departments.tagline: Hardware, software and the systems that connect them. (sample)
departments.overview:
The Department of Computer Engineering teaches hardware, software and the systems that connect them through lectures, labs and project work, following the Pokhara University curriculum. Coursework covers programming, digital logic, microprocessors, computer networks and embedded systems.

In the final year, students complete a project with a supervisor from the department. (Sample text: the Head of Department replaces it from the dashboard.)
